Bids should be submitted as per following instructions only: PART-I: PRE-QUALIFICATION DOCUMENTS, if applicable + TECHNO-COMMERCIAL BID, if any should contain following :- ATC/Packet-1: Scanned copy of i) Annexure-IV i.e. ‘Undertaking for NO DEVIATION’ printed on bidders letter head duly signed and stamped by appropriate authority. ii) Annexure-VI i.e. ‘Tax Compliance Clauses related to GST’ printed on bidders letter head duly signed and stamped by appropriate authority. iii) Annexure-XIIA ‘Model Certificate for Tenders’ printed on bidder letter head duly signed and stamped by appropriate authority [i.e. as per 144(xi) of GFR-2017]. (If any, please submit signed stamped copy of corrigendum’s for subject tender uploaded on GeM portal) iv) Valid MSE certificate etc. v) Annexure-XVIIA i.e. ‘Declaration of Status of Debarment Listing/ Blacklisting/ Holiday Listing duly signed and stamped by appropriate authority. vi) Annexure-XVIIB i.e. ‘Undertaking about common Directors/ Partners/ Interest in other associated units/ companies’ duly signed and stamped by appropriate authority. ATC/Packet-2: Scanned copy of “Duly filled, signed and stamped copy of the Technical Bid / Check list i.e. A nnexure-III” and any other documents, if requested in scope of work, mentioned in tender document. ATC/Packet-3: Scanned copy of Annexure-XIV i.e. INTEGRITY PACT (duly filled with date, stamp & sign on e ach page by appropriate authority) ATC/Packet-4: Scanned copy of “Vendor Data Updation form i.e. Annexure-X, along with all the supporting documents, cancelled cheque etc.” PART-II: PRICED BID:- For tender on GeM portal – Follow GeM guidelines as mentioned in GeM portal. Also submit the price break -up in the format as given with the tender. Bidder have to quote for all items mentioned in the price break-up format. The quoted item wise unit rates must be in whole numbers only, pls. do not quote item wise unit rates in decimal places. Vendor should quote prices as per above only. Offers indicating rates anywhere else (scanned documents etc.) shall be liable for rejection. .
